project_title: Mortgage Risk Under Changing Economic Conditions
dataset: Freddie Mac Single-Family Loan-Level Dataset samples
target: 90+ day serious delinquency within the first 24 months
responsible_use: This project is an educational portfolio analysis of historical mortgage performance. Results describe statistical associations and model behavior across historical loan cohorts and economic environments. They should not be interpreted as causal effects or used to make individual lending, underwriting, pricing, or eligibility decisions.
